_readme: The one place for citation metadata. Read by the app (/data, the Cite dialog), scripts/build-sites-json.py (CITATION.cff, public/data/datapackage.json), scripts/prerender.mjs (JSON-LD) and scripts/export-wikimedia.py. After editing, run `npm run data`.

todo.author: TODO(author): replace with the author's name as it should be cited (add ORCID and affiliation to CITATION.cff if wanted).
todo.licence: TODO(author): choose a licence. Set licence to its name (e.g. "CC BY 4.0") and licenceSpdx to its SPDX id (e.g. "CC-BY-4.0"); the machine-readable files pick it up.
todo.datum: TODO(author): confirm the datum of the recorded coordinates. If it is WGS 84, set datum to "WGS 84" and datumConfirmed to true.

datasetDescription: Records of Khasa Malla (12th to 14th century) historical sites across western Nepal, India and Tibet: pillars, steles, devals, temples and inscriptions, transcribed from the project's field documentation.
author: The Himalayas Project
licence: to be confirmed by the author

fields.name: id
fields.description: Identifier used in this atlas and its URLs, for example site-12.

fields.name: entry_no
fields.description: Entry number in the project documentation, for example N.D.D.12.

fields.name: district
fields.description: District or region. "N/A" where the record gives none.

fields.name: coordinates
fields.description: Coordinates as recorded, in decimal degrees or degrees, minutes and seconds. Empty where none were recorded.

fields.name: site_type
fields.description: Type of site or object as recorded.

fields.name: documentation
fields.description: Field notes: condition, measurements and observations.

fields.name: visit_date
fields.description: Date of the site visit (YYYY-MM-DD). This is not the date of the monument.

fields.name: language
fields.description: Language of an inscription. Empty for every record at present.

fields.name: translation
fields.description: Translation of an inscription. Empty for every record at present.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The source the record draws on, as given in the documentation.

fields.name: site_categories
fields.description: Normalised categories derived from site_type for filtering, so that "Pillar" and "Pillars" group together. A site can have several. A list in JSON and GeoJSON; separated by "; " in the CSV.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Decimal degrees parsed from coordinates and rounded to six places. Empty where there are no coordinates. In GeoJSON, latitude and longitude form the point geometry, in [longitude, latitude] order.

fields.name: possibly_related
fields.description: Entry numbers of records that may describe the same site or object. An editorial cross-reference from a short list in scripts/build-sites-json.py (POSSIBLY_RELATED), not a statement in the documentation; no records are merged. A list in JSON and GeoJSON; separated by "; " in the CSV.

fields.name: images
fields.description: Photographs of the site. Empty for every record at present: no photographs have been published. To add one, put the file in public/images/sites/ and add an entry to IMAGES in scripts/build-sites-json.py, keyed by entry_no, with src, alt, credit and licence; then run `npm run data`. A list of objects in JSON and GeoJSON; the src values separated by "; " in the CSV.
